interfaces: DeveloperValidationCheckResult { validatorId, category, required, status, evidenceOutcome, diagnostics, evidenceLineageId, evidenceSequence }
DeveloperValidationResult { taskId, outcome, lifecycleState, revision, startedAt, finishedAt, checks, failedCheckIds, evidenceLocation }

behavioralConstraints: validate() only accepts a task whose current lifecycle state is IN_DEVELOPMENT; every other state is rejected as TASK_STATE_NOT_VALIDATABLE before any validator runs
canonical branch identity is asserted before validator resolution or evidence persistence, so a wrong-branch invocation never executes checks or writes evidence
validators are resolved through the pluggable DeveloperValidatorResolver boundary and executed through the unmodified BOOT-014 ValidationExecutor in the exact order resolved
every validator result is persisted as an ipt.validation-evidence record bound to the exact current branch head revision before the gate trusts it

the gate reads persisted evidence back through checkRevision (not only the in-memory ValidationExecutor result) to confirm each record is CURRENT for the exact revision before deciding the lifecycle transition
a validator ERROR status is recorded as evidence outcome BLOCKED, distinct from FAIL, but is treated the same as FAIL for the required-check aggregate
the lifecycle transitions to DEV_VALIDATED only when every required validator's persisted, revision-checked evidence is PASS; any other required outcome transitions to DEV_VALIDATION_FAILED instead
an optional (non-required) validator's FAIL or ERROR status is recorded as evidence but never blocks DEV_VALIDATED

the lifecycle transition is committed through the unmodified BOOT-009 state machine with FAILURE_EVIDENCE_RECORDED or DEV_VALIDATION_PASSED as the satisfied prerequisite, and is persisted only after every required evidence record is confirmed CURRENT

the result identifies every check's validator ID, category, required flag, status, evidence outcome, diagnostics, and the exact evidence lineage/sequence it was recorded at, plus a failedCheckIds list of required checks that did not pass
invariants: the gate performs no QA, Architecture, or UAT review
the gate creates no pull request and performs no merge-readiness computation
the gate does not invoke an AI provider
the gate never advances lifecycle state from evidence it has not itself just recorded and revision-checked as CURRENT
a branch, resolution, or evidence-persistence failure leaves the task's lifecycle state unchanged
examples: an IN_DEVELOPMENT task on its canonical branch with all required validators passing advances to DEV_VALIDATED with one CURRENT evidence record per validator
the same task with one required validator failing advances to DEV_VALIDATION_FAILED instead, with the failing validator's ID in failedCheckIds
a validator that errors (crashes or times out) is recorded as evidence outcome BLOCKED and is treated as a failing required check
after a successful validation, checking the recorded evidence against a different revision identity returns REVISION_MISMATCH rather than being mistaken for evidence of the new revision
edgeCases: a task not currently IN_DEVELOPMENT is rejected as TASK_STATE_NOT_VALIDATABLE before branch identity is even checked
an unregistered task ID is rejected as TASK_NOT_FOUND
a wrong current branch is rejected as BRANCH_REJECTED before any validator is resolved or executed
an empty resolved validator set is rejected as VALIDATOR_RESOLUTION_FAILED
an evidence record rejected by the BOOT-015 store's schema validation surfaces as EVIDENCE_REJECTED rather than silently proceeding
a stale expected lifecycle state at commit time is rejected as STATE_CONFLICT rather than overwriting a concurrent transition

expectations: a task only enters QA/Architecture/UAT review after this gate has recorded a DEV_VALIDATED transition backed by revision-bound, schema-validated evidence
the exact revision the review pipeline evaluates matches the revisionIdentity recorded on the gate's evidence
acceptedRanges: a DeveloperValidationResult with outcome PASS and lifecycleState DEV_VALIDATED
a DeveloperValidationResult with outcome FAIL and lifecycleState DEV_VALIDATION_FAILED
requiredReachableRanges: a required-check failure that blocks DEV_VALIDATED
explicit branch/task/revision-identity rejection before evidence is trusted

expectations: the developer validation gate remains a deterministic, provider-neutral boundary between IN_DEVELOPMENT and independent review
a validation run's structured failure detail is sufficient to route a task back to development without additional narrative interpretation
acceptedRanges: PASS or FAIL DeveloperValidationResult, or a structured DeveloperValidationError
